name: obsidian-daily-echoes
description: Revisit your daily notes from previous years: on this day, this week, this month, or this day of the month.
author: Wojciech Polak

scripts.check: npm run check:versions && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run build && npm run test
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && node scripts/release-changelog.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json CHANGELOG.md
scripts.postversion: printf 'Tagged %s.\nPush it with: git push origin main %s\n' "$npm_package_version" "$npm_package_version"
